description: Layout and CTA patterns for marketing-style surfaces from UI UX Pro Max.

items.primary_cta_placement: Hero (sticky) + Bottom
items.color_strategy: Hero: Brand primary or vibrant. Features: Card bg #FAFAFA. CTA: Contrasting accent color
items.conversion_optimization: Deep CTA placement. Use contrasting color (at least 7:1 contrast ratio). Sticky navbar CTA.

items.primary_cta_placement: Hero (sticky) + Post-testimonials
items.color_strategy: Hero: Brand color. Testimonials: Light bg #F5F5F5. Quotes: Italic, muted color #666. CTA: Vibrant
items.conversion_optimization: Social proof before CTA. Use 3-5 testimonials. Include photo + name + role. CTA after social proof.

items.primary_cta_placement: Video center + CTA right/bottom
items.color_strategy: Video surround: Brand color overlay. Features: Icon color #0080FF. Text: Dark #222
items.conversion_optimization: Embedded product demo increases engagement. Use interactive mockup if possible. Auto-play video muted.

items.primary_cta_placement: Center, large CTA button
items.color_strategy: Minimalist: Brand + white #FFFFFF + accent. Buttons: High contrast 7:1+. Text: Black/Dark grey
recommended_effects: Minimal hover effects. Smooth scroll. CTA scale on hover (subtle)
items.conversion_optimization: Single CTA focus. Large typography. Lots of whitespace. No nav clutter. Mobile-first.

items.primary_cta_placement: Each step: mini-CTA. Final: main CTA
items.color_strategy: Step colors: 1 (Red/Problem), 2 (Orange/Process), 3 (Green/Solution). CTA: Brand color
items.conversion_optimization: Progressive disclosure. Show only essential info per step. Use progress indicators. Multiple CTAs.

items.primary_cta_placement: Table: Right column. CTA: Below table
items.color_strategy: Table: Alternating rows (white/light grey). Your product: Highlight #FFFACD (light yellow) or green. Text: Dark
items.conversion_optimization: Use comparison to show unique value. Highlight your product row. Include 'free trial' in pricing row.

items.primary_cta_placement: Form CTA: Submit button
items.color_strategy: Lead magnet: Professional design. Form: Clean white bg. Inputs: Light border #CCCCCC. CTA: Brand color
items.conversion_optimization: Form fields ≤ 3 for best conversion. Offer valuable lead magnet preview. Show form submission progress.

items.primary_cta_placement: Each card: CTA button. Sticky CTA in nav
items.color_strategy: Free: Grey, Starter: Blue, Pro: Green/Gold, Enterprise: Dark. Cards: 1px border, shadow
items.conversion_optimization: Recommend starter plan (pre-select/highlight). Show annual discount (20-30%). Use FAQs to address concerns.

items.primary_cta_placement: Overlay on video (center/bottom) + Bottom section
items.color_strategy: Dark overlay 60% on video. Brand accent for CTA. White text on dark.
items.conversion_optimization: 86% higher engagement with video. Add captions for accessibility. Compress video for performance.

items.primary_cta_placement: End of each chapter (mini) + Final climax CTA
items.color_strategy: Progressive reveal. Each chapter has distinct color. Building intensity.
items.conversion_optimization: Narrative increases time-on-page 3x. Use progress indicator. Mobile: simplify animations.

items.primary_cta_placement: Context-aware placement based on user segment
items.color_strategy: Adaptive based on user data. A/B test color variations per segment.
items.conversion_optimization: 20%+ conversion with personalization. Requires analytics integration. Fallback for new users.

items.primary_cta_placement: Email form prominent (above fold) + Sticky form on scroll
items.color_strategy: Anticipation: Dark + accent highlights. Countdown in brand color. Urgency indicators.
items.conversion_optimization: Scarcity + exclusivity. Show waitlist count. Early access benefits. Referral program.

items.primary_cta_placement: After comparison table (highlighted row) + Bottom
items.color_strategy: Your product column highlighted (accent bg or green). Competitors neutral. Checkmarks green.
items.conversion_optimization: Show value vs competitors. 35% higher conversion. Be factual. Include pricing if favorable.

items.primary_cta_placement: Each pricing card + Sticky CTA in nav + Bottom
items.color_strategy: Popular plan highlighted (brand color border/bg). Free: grey. Enterprise: dark/premium.
items.conversion_optimization: Annual discount 20-30%. Recommend mid-tier (most popular badge). Address objections in FAQ.

items.primary_cta_placement: Download buttons prominent (App Store + Play Store) throughout
items.color_strategy: Dark/light matching app store feel. Star ratings in gold. Screenshots with device frames.
items.conversion_optimization: Show real screenshots. Include ratings (4.5+ stars). QR code for mobile. Platform-specific CTAs.

items.primary_cta_placement: Search bar prominent + Contact CTA for unresolved questions
items.color_strategy: Clean, high readability. Minimal color. Category icons in brand color. Success green for resolved.
items.conversion_optimization: Reduce support tickets. Track search analytics. Show related articles. Contact escalation path.

items.primary_cta_placement: After interaction complete + Skip option for impatient users
items.color_strategy: Immersive experience colors. Dark background for focus. Highlight interactive elements.
items.conversion_optimization: 40% higher engagement. Performance trade-off. Provide skip option. Mobile fallback essential.

items.primary_cta_placement: Register CTA sticky + After speakers + Bottom
items.color_strategy: Urgency colors (countdown). Event branding. Speaker cards professional. Sponsor logos neutral.
items.conversion_optimization: Early bird pricing with deadline. Social proof (past attendees). Speaker credibility. Multi-ticket discounts.

items.primary_cta_placement: After reviews summary + Buy button alongside reviews
items.color_strategy: Trust colors. Star ratings gold. Verified badge green. Review sentiment colors.
items.conversion_optimization: User-generated content builds trust. Show verified purchases. Filter by rating. Respond to negative reviews.

items.primary_cta_placement: Join button prominent + After member showcase
items.color_strategy: Warm, welcoming. Member photos add humanity. Topic badges in brand colors. Activity indicators green.
items.conversion_optimization: Show active community (member count, posts today). Highlight benefits. Preview content. Easy onboarding.

items.primary_cta_placement: After transformation reveal + Bottom
items.color_strategy: Contrast: muted/grey (before) vs vibrant/colorful (after). Success green for results.
items.conversion_optimization: Visual proof of value. 45% higher conversion. Real results. Specific metrics. Guarantee offer.

items.primary_cta_placement: Hero Search Bar + Navbar 'List your item'
items.color_strategy: Search: High contrast. Categories: Visual icons. Trust: Blue/Green.
items.conversion_optimization: Search bar is the CTA. Reduce friction to search. Popular searches suggestions.

items.primary_cta_placement: Hero inline form + Sticky header form
items.color_strategy: Minimalist. Paper-like background. Text focus. Accent color for Subscribe.
items.conversion_optimization: Single field form (Email only). Show 'Join X, 000 readers'. Read sample link.

items.primary_cta_placement: Hero (Right side form) + Bottom anchor
items.color_strategy: Urgency: Red/Orange. Professional: Blue/Navy. Form: High contrast white.
items.conversion_optimization: Limited seats logic. 'Live' indicator. Auto-fill timezone.

items.primary_cta_placement: Contact Sales (Primary) + Login (Secondary)
items.color_strategy: Corporate: Navy/Grey. High integrity. Conservative accents.
items.conversion_optimization: Path selection (I am a...). Mega menu navigation. Trust signals prominent.

items.primary_cta_placement: Project Card Hover + Footer Contact
items.color_strategy: Neutral background (let work shine). Text: Black/White. Accent: Minimal.
items.conversion_optimization: Visuals first. Filter by category. Fast loading essential.

items.primary_cta_placement: Floating Sticky CTA or End of Horizontal Track
items.color_strategy: Continuous palette transition. Chapter colors. Progress bar #000000.
items.conversion_optimization: Immersive product discovery. High engagement. Keep navigation visible.

items.primary_cta_placement: Floating Action Button or Bottom of Grid
items.color_strategy: Card backgrounds: #F5F5F7 or Glass. Icons: Vibrant brand colors. Text: Dark.
items.conversion_optimization: Scannable value props. High information density without clutter. Mobile stack.

items.primary_cta_placement: Inside Configurator UI + Sticky Bottom Bar
items.color_strategy: Neutral studio background. Product: Realistic materials. UI: Minimal overlay.
items.conversion_optimization: Increases ownership feeling. 360 view reduces return rates. Direct add-to-cart.

items.primary_cta_placement: Input Field (Hero) + 'Try it' Buttons
items.color_strategy: Adaptive to user input. Dark mode for compute feel. Neon accents.
items.conversion_optimization: Immediate value demonstration. 'Show, don't tell'. Low friction start.

items.primary_cta_placement: Hero (sticky) + After features + Bottom
items.color_strategy: Brand primary + card bg #FAFAFA. Feature icons accent. CTA contrasting.
items.conversion_optimization: Clear feature hierarchy. One key message per card. Strong CTA repetition.

items.primary_cta_placement: Hero dominant (center/bottom) + Sticky nav CTA
items.color_strategy: Hero: High-impact visual. Minimal text. CTA 7:1 contrast.
items.conversion_optimization: One primary CTA. Hero is 60-80% above fold. Mobile: same hierarchy.

items.primary_cta_placement: Contact Sales / Get Quote (primary) + Nav
items.color_strategy: Navy/Grey corporate. Trust blue. Accent for CTA only.
items.conversion_optimization: Security badges. Case studies. Transparent pricing. Low-friction form.

items.primary_cta_placement: Primary CTA in nav + After metrics
items.color_strategy: Dark or neutral. Status colors (green/amber/red). Data-dense but scannable.
items.conversion_optimization: For ops/security/iot products. Demo or sandbox link. Trust signals.
